{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Replace -1 in customer_age with NaN
data['customer_age'] = data['customer_age'].replace(-1, pd.NA)

# Remove rows with revenue = '999,999.99' (QA orders)
data_clean = data[data['revenue'] != '999,999.99']

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
data_clean['revenue'] = data_clean['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
data_clean['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(data_clean['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Remove refunded orders (status == 'refunded')
data_clean = data_clean[data_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute conversion rate within each segment, then compare channel effect
conversion_by_segment_channel = data_clean.groupby(['customer_segment', 'channel'])['converted'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)

# Compute the difference in conversion rates (paid_search - email) within each segment
channel_diff = conversion_by_segment_channel['paid_search'] - conversion_by_segment_channel['email']

# Print all key numbers for grounding
print("=== KEY RESULTS FOR GROUNDING ===")
print(f"Number of completed orders after cleaning: {len(data_clean)}")
print("\nConversion rate by segment and channel:")
print(conversion_by_segment_channel)
print("\nDifference in conversion rates (paid_search - email) by segment:")
print(channel_diff)

# Explicitly print the returning segment difference as a float
returning_diff = channel_diff['returning']
print(f"\nDifference in returning segment (paid_search - email): {returning_diff}")

# Compute overall difference in conversion rates (paid_search - email)
overall_diff = conversion_by_segment_channel['paid_search'].mean() - conversion_by_segment_channel['email'].mean()
print(f"\nOverall difference (paid_search - email): {overall_diff:.4f}")

# Compute weighted average of differences, by segment size
segment_sizes = data_clean['customer_segment'].value_counts(normalize=True)
weighted_diff = (channel_diff * segment_sizes).sum()
print(f"Weighted difference (by segment size): {weighted_diff:.4f}")

# Print email and paid_search overall conversion rates
email_rate = conversion_by_segment_channel['email'].mean()
paid_search_rate = conversion_by_segment_channel['paid_search'].mean()
print(f"Email conversion rate: {email_rate:.4f}")
print(f"Paid_search conversion rate: {paid_search_rate:.4f}")"}
